title: North Ostrobothnia: 2.5 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €98,500 a year
markdown:
# North Ostrobothnia: 2.5 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €98,500 a year

> Closes 2.5 of 7.1 missing patients a year (35%) · €98,500 of €1M · €901,500 left: nothing more pays off on today's evidence

## The gap

Of 100 lung cancer patients in North Ostrobothnia, 24 get treatment that aims to cure. In Finland it is 27. That is about 7 patients a year. [^care_curative] Against the best quarter of counties, 14.2 patients a year are missing (range 8.5–19.4) [^model]. Against Finland as a whole, 7.1 fewer get radiotherapy that aims to cure and 0.0 fewer are operated [^model]. Waits in the OYS collaborative area are not longer: 31.2 days from diagnosis to treatment, against 36.9 in Finland [^care_time_to_treatment]. Fewer are treated to cure [^care_curative]. The share is also below the 29.7% that residents' age would predict [^model].

## The target

Raise the share of lung cancer patients treated to cure from 23.6% to 24.8% by 2028: 2.5 more patients a year (range 0.0–5.0), for €98,500 a year, about €39,718 per extra patient. [^care_curative][^model] That closes 35% of the measured shortfall against Finland as a whole (7.1 patients a year). [^model]

## Funded actions

| # | Action and owner | Cost a year | More patients treated to cure a year (range) | First step this week | Measure: today → target |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | **The county can start on Monday** | | | | |
| 1 | **Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated**[^ev_sbrt_pathway_1]. Chief physician of oncology; chief of radiotherapy at the university hospital | €44,000 | 1.7 (0.0–3.4) | Write the referral rule: every stage I patient not accepted for surgery is referred for stereotactic radiotherapy the same week. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 23.6% → 24.4% by 2028 |
| 2 | **Fitness test and training before anyone is ruled too frail for curative treatment**[^ev_prehab_fitness_assessment_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; leads of rehabilitation and geriatrics | €54,500 | 0.8 (0.0–1.7) | Decide that no stage I-III patient is recorded as "not fit" without an exercise test, and book the physiotherapy group. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 23.6% → 24.0% by 2028 |
| | **Total** | **€98,500** | **2.5 (0.0–5.0)** | | |

No trial has measured these effects; the low end of every range is zero. The ranges do not add up to the range of the total, because the measures share one ceiling. Costs are assumptions. [^model]

## Needs a national decision (outside this budget)

- **Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers**[^ev_ldct_screening_1]: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko (decision), Finnish Cancer Registry (steering), county (delivery). €1,273,817 a year; modelled to avoid 2.2 deaths a year (0.5–5.8). Not counted in this budget. Not a county decision. Ask the Ministry and Palko for the timetable after the 2026-2028 pilot and offer the county as a pilot site. [^model]

## What to measure from Monday

- Share of patients treated to cure: 23.6% (2019–2023, measured) → 24.8% by 2028. [^care_curative][^model]
- The registry's public figures cover 2019–2023; count these each month from the county's own records. [^care_curative]

## What more money buys, and what it cannot

The remaining €901,500 buys nothing more toward treatment to cure: these measures are limited by the reachable part of the measured shortfall, not by money [^model]. To see what else could be done, look at low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers, which needs a national decision, or rank measures by deaths avoided instead [^model]. Lung cancer causes about 165 deaths a year in North Ostrobothnia [^deaths]; this plan is modelled to avoid 0.4 of them (0.0–1.5) [^model].

## Pilot ask

A six-month pilot of two actions: a chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate, and every patient who cannot be operated is referred for precise radiotherapy. In six months that is about 105 new patients and 89 decisions reviewed. If our assumptions hold, about 1 of them (0 to 2) move to treatment that aims to cure in that time, and the share rises from 23.6% to 24.4% by 2028. The pilot replaces those assumptions with a count. [^model]

## Limits

- Effect ranges are not probabilities: they run from every assumption at its lowest to every assumption at its highest [^model].
- Shares are adjusted only for residents' age, not for stage, fitness, histology, smoking or recording; county figures cannot show cause [^model].
- A check of the estimated symptom-to-treatment clock against measured outcomes did not confirm it (0 of 3 outcomes) [^model].

removed.reason: The clause 'is not used in this plan' is not in the source, which calls the clock a secondary view. The clause was cut and the rest of the sentence was kept.

flagged.sentence: More would come from low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers, which needs a national decision, or from ranking measures by deaths avoided instead [^model].
flagged.reason: The source only points to these as places to look ('to see what else the money could do'). It gives no figure showing that screening would add patients treated to cure, and screening cannot be bought from a county budget. The sentence was reworded so it no longer claims a gain.

In six months that is about 105 new patients and 89 decisions reviewed. pilot.text_fi: Kuuden kuukauden pilotti kahdesta toimesta: rintakirurgi arvioi jokaisen päätöksen jättää leikkaamatta, ja jokainen potilas, jota ei voida leikata, lähetetään stereotaktiseen sädehoitoon. Kuudessa kuukaudessa se tarkoittaa noin 105 uutta potilasta ja 89 arvioitua päätöstä. Jos oletuksemme pitävät, noin 1 heistä (0–2) siirtyy sinä aikana parantavaan hoitoon, ja osuus nousee 23,6 %:sta 24,4 %:iin vuoteen 2028 mennessä. Pilotti korvaa oletukset lasketuilla luvuilla.
pilot.cannot_show_en: Six months is too short to show the county's share moving. It is long enough to count reviews done, decisions changed and referrals made, against the same six months a year earlier.
pilot.cannot_show_fi: Kuusi kuukautta on liian lyhyt aika osoittamaan alueen osuuden muutosta. Se riittää laskemaan tehdyt arviot, muuttuneet päätökset ja lähetteet ja vertaamaan niitä samaan jaksoon vuotta aiemmin.
